$comment: The adapter layer (CONTEXT.md 适配层; ADR-0007's north star, now CI-enforced per ADR-0023): the ONLY files allowed to directly import @deepseek-ai/* packages. This list is the reviewed boundary fact — scripts/lint-dsh-adapter.mjs fails when a file outside it adds such an import, or when a listed file no longer exists/imports nothing dsh (a stale entry). Changes here ride the same review as dsh-matrix changes. Scan scope: repo .js/.mjs except node_modules, web, facet, openspec, docs, e2e (test harness has its own rules), dist trees, and dsh-matrix itself (lock/tooling, not code).
